summary: Tested KYC form changes: (1) co-borrower/guarantor phone optional label, (2) advancing without phone, (3) success screen after KYC submission. All 4 features verified via Playwright with React state injection to navigate form steps.
seed_data_creation: No new data created. Success screen tested with React state injection (mock successData).
context_for_next_testing_agent: KYC form changes from iteration 31 are verified PASSING. Features tested: (1) Co-borrower phone shows '(optional)' label when isMandatory=false, (2) Can advance step 3→4 without co-borrower phone, (3) Guarantor phone shows '(optional)' label, (4) Can advance step 4→5 without guarantor phone, (5) Success screen renders with Customer ID + Client Name + 'Loan Disbursed / कर्ज जारी हुआ' badge + 'View Client Profile' button, (6) View Client Profile button navigates to /clients/{kycId}. Testing approach used React fiber state injection to navigate steps without filling the full form (Aadhaar upload + live photo not mockable in Playwright). The actual end-to-end submission with real KYC data was NOT tested due to camera/file upload constraints.

testing_notes: Success screen was tested using React fiber state injection (mocking successData) rather than full end-to-end form submission. This is a valid UI test for the rendering logic. The actual API submission flow requires real Aadhaar photo uploads and live camera photo which cannot be automated in headless Playwright. Code review confirms the submission logic correctly sets successData on create mode (not on edit mode).
